result.reason: The added clause includes all preferred coverages and limits, including CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. Because HDI processes customer data, the cyber requirement is appropriately triggered. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not necessary to reach the stated position. The original provision and unrelated commercial intent are otherwise preserved, and the drafting is professional.
